title: Mishlove's prize-winning Bigelow essay on survival of consciousness

tellings.quote: Bigalow asked for an essay on the strongest evidence that human consciousness will survive permanent bodily death.

plain: Jeffrey Mishlove is a researcher with a doctorate who studies psychic claims. He says that in 2021 a wealthy businessman, Robert Bigelow, ran an essay contest asking for the strongest evidence that the human mind survives the death of the body. On a podcast hosted by Jesse Michels, Mishlove says he wrote one of the winning essays, which, if its case holds, would mean consciousness goes on after death.
